brandingSettings.dtfHelperNote: Direct-to-fabric (DTF) printing is recommended for larger, multi-color, or photo-realistic designs, and works best on flatter areas like full front/back placements on t-shirts and hoodies.
brandingSettings.embroideryHelperNote: Embroidery is recommended for structured, smaller logos (chest, sleeve, caps, pockets) and holds up best on woven/heavier fabrics.
